sci-repo-y8-kol-2021-particlemodel-mc-1.title: Year 8 Science — Particle model formative test — Kolbe 2021 (original source MC)
sci-repo-y8-kol-2021-particlemodel-mc-1.coverage: Original assessment questions with source figures. Written parts remain in the bank with marks and parent context. Review-required items excluded from automatic battles.

questions.prompt: Which scenario described below indicates a physical change has occurred in a substance?
options: A bowl of water is placed in the freezer
Bacon and eggs are cooked for breakfast
Glow sticks are snapped, shaken slightly and then begin to glow
While out camping, wood is lit in a campfire and is used for cooking
questions.explanation: Freezing water changes its physical state; the substance remains water.

questions.prompt: Which one of the following combination of terms defines the changes of state between solids and liquids?
questions.explanation: Melting and freezing connect solid and liquid.

questions.prompt: Which one of the following combination of terms define the changes of state between solids and gases?
questions.explanation: Sublimation is solid→gas; deposition is gas→solid.

questions.prompt: When a water jug is placed in a refrigerator, the liquid in the container is cooled. During this process the particles in the liquid:
options: Move to the bottom of the jug
Lose their energy and move more slowly
Have cold energy added to them
questions.explanation: Cooling lowers the average kinetic energy of the liquid particles; they move more slowly. Particles themselves do not shrink and there is no “cold energy” substance.
